name: The Frosty Leaves - Hanye Xia de Bo Bing
original_name: The Frosty Leaves 寒叶下的薄冰
source:
This is a tragedy cause by illegal plant collecting. The main character, Leng Xiaobing, was a normal shop keeper form a grocery store, but ever things changed after she met a strange man…

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/794950/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一场非法植物采集造成的悲剧。主角冷小冰本是一家杂货店的普通店主，但自从她遇到了一个陌生男人后，一切都发生了变化……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/794950/]Steam[/url]]
